prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1498
Claimant:
Allen Yang
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
23 Oct 2023
Claim received for a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The insured's vehicle was struck from behind while
stopped, and the claimant reports a wrist fracture from the impact. Claimant is represented by counsel, and all further
contact will go through the attorney's office.
20 Nov 2023
Reviewed the police report, scene photos and written statements from two witnesses. All three describe the same
sequence: the insured stopped at the light and the following vehicle made contact at moderate speed. The other
driver confirmed the account by phone and admitted to following too closely.
15 Dec 2023
Rear bumper, trunk lid and tail light assembly damage on the insured vehicle is consistent with the described impact
height and direction. Photos show no sign of older repairs or prior damage in the affected areas. Records confirm the
policy was in force well before the loss, with no indication of earlier damage to the vehicle.
17 Dec 2023
Confirmed that the driver of the insured vehicle lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member
under the policy terms. Coverage question is closed. Position of the claimant within the vehicle at impact is not fully
clear from the statements and photos, and counsel has been asked to clarify this.
17 Mar 2024
Medical records received through counsel show a wrist fracture treated with immobilization and follow-up visits.
Treatment followed a typical course, and visit frequency tapered as the claimant improved. No prior injury to the same
area appears in the records obtained.
30 Mar 2024
Claimant's account has stayed consistent across the first contact, recorded statement and follow-up conversation
with counsel present. The injury description fits the kind and force of the collision. Reserve reviewed and file remains
open pending the claimant's response on seating position and the final medical summary.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
